qolFindings.title: The SP-WX1-1 fix has no browser test; only unit tests pin it
qolFindings.evidence: aa944b6..a08fa95 adds two cases to src/features/weather/useWindForecast.test.ts that drive watchLocalData directly. tests/e2e/weather.spec.ts still has no two-tab journey. Round 1 showed how a unit test can pass while a real browser behaves differently: a synthetic StorageEvent that no browser would fire. A BroadcastChannel round trip between two real pages is the part a unit test cannot prove.
qolFindings.reproduction: My throwaway two-tab spec (below) passes on pixel-7 and Desktop Chrome. It is not in the repository.
qolFindings.specRef: 04_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md WX1 adversarial checklist ('the course erased in another tab')
qolFindings.recommendedFix: Add the two cases to weather.spec.ts: the first download held, and a refresh held over an existing copy. Then erase in a second page of the same context, and assert no weather key and the 'Il corso è cambiato' screen in the first page.

qolFindings.title: The 45-minute floor for a copy whose extras failed is kept in memory and lost on reload
qolFindings.evidence: useWindForecast.ts: extrasFailed is a module-level Map, keyed by zone and fetch time. After a reload, a stored copy without an ensemble falls back to the 5-minute floor once, until the next download sets it again. This adds at most one extra refresh per reload. It is not a blocker and does not reopen SP-WX1-3 in substance.
qolFindings.reproduction: Code reading of the fix diff.
qolFindings.recommendedFix: Optional: store a marker in the copy itself, for example extrasFailedAt, instead of keeping it in memory.

evidenceInspected: Re-test of SP-WX1-1 (blocker): git diff aa944b6..a08fa95 for src/persistence/courses.ts (announceCourseReplacement at the end of eraseAllCourseData) and src/features/weather/useWindForecast.ts (watchLocalData subscription in network mode: sets removedElsewhere, aborts synchronously, removes this zone's key, goes idle; unsubscribed in cleanup). Also read src/persistence/localDataOperations.ts (the BroadcastChannel 'changed' handling, the sticky module state, closeCourse), src/App.tsx:971-1012 (any notice puts the app in 'closed' and unmounts Vento), and src/persistence/serverErasures.ts:56-64 (a synced erase already announced before disconnecting, so a synced erase now announces twice, which is harmless)

Throwaway Playwright spec, deleted afterwards: same context, two pages, synthetic Deriva course, weather hosts mocked with tests/e2e/weatherFixtures.ts. Case A: first download held, erase in tab B, release. Weather keys [], tab A shows 'Il corso è cambiato ... Riapri l'app' with no Vento heading, and a later visibilitychange makes no request (1 → 1). Case B: a whole copy exists, Aggiorna held, erase in tab B, release. Keys [], tab A closed, no request after visibilitychange (4 → 4). Same results on pixel-7 and Desktop Chrome. In round 1, case A left cvc-helper.weather.v3.derive behind and tab A stayed on Vento. SP-WX1-1 is resolved.

Regression from the fix: a local erase now closes other tabs of the same app on the 'Il corso è cambiato' screen, the one an import and a synced erase already used. I judge this an improvement, not a regression: before, tab A stayed on an erased course whose screens could no longer save. In case C (tab A on Home, erase in tab B), tab B goes on to create a new course normally, the erasing tab does not receive its own message (BroadcastChannel does not echo to the sender), tab A reopens on the new course after Riapri or reload, and no weather request is made. The sticky module state in watchLocalData cannot leave a later Vento silenced, because any notice puts the whole app in 'closed' until a reload resets the module.

Checked the fixes to the non-blocking round-1 findings: 03 §3.4 now says Open-Meteo gets no cookies and LaMMA's image carries LaMMA's cookies (SP-WX1-2). 03 §3.4 Refresh describes the 45-minute wait after failed extras, with a unit test (SP-WX1-3). docs/DEPLOY.md names Whisper, Vento and the backup hosts, and the CSP list includes huggingface.co and the backup hosts (SP-WX1-4). The courses.test.ts comment is fixed (SP-WX1-Q4). SP-WX1-Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q5 were moved to the backlog, as the coordinator stated.

lenses: Round 2, restricted scope with no draw: re-tested blocker SP-WX1-1 in a real browser (both round-1 cases plus a Home-only case), and looked for regressions from the fix (other tabs closing on a local erase, the erasing tab itself, the sticky notice state, a synced erase announcing twice)
